info.title: Planning migration preparation and immutable composition
info.description:
Current Inventory bindings and separately commissioned immutable migration recipes. Composition creates a new plan for independent approval; it does not grant native execution. Maximum request 32768 bytes. Version 1.2 explicitly reports deterministic commissioning holds (423).
Version 1.6 publishes owner network choices, scoped selection and resolved workload readiness; none grant execution.
